item.title: Antoine Griezmann Joins Orlando City: The Surprising MLS Move
item.description:
Antoine Griezmann Joins Orlando City: The Surprising MLS Move

A World Cup winner and Atletico Madrid’s all-time leading scorer just chose purple over the Spanish spotlight. Antoine Griezmann has officially traded La Liga for Major League Soccer, and his very first appearance in an Orlando City shirt could not have gone any better.

Key Takeaways

  • Griezmann joins Orlando City from Atletico Madrid as a Designated Player, signed through the 2027-28 season with an option for 2028-29.
  • He scored a goal and added an assist in a 6-0 friendly win over the Tampa Bay Rowdies during his first 48 hours with the club.
  • The 35-year-old is a 2018 World Cup champion and Atletico’s record scorer with 211 goals in 488 games.
  • His MLS debut is expected later in July, setting up a much-anticipated showdown with Lionel Messi.

This is not a routine signing. It is a statement that MLS continues to attract some of the biggest names in world football at the peak of their reputations.

item.title: América vs Nashville SC: CONCACAF Champions Cup Quarterfinal Showdown Explained
item.description:
A 0-0 draw might sound dull on paper — but when it puts an MLS club one step from a CONCACAF Champions Cup semifinal against one of Mexico’s most decorated teams, every scoreless minute carries weight.

Key Takeaways

  • Nashville SC and Club América drew 0-0 in the first leg at GEODIS Park on April 8, 2026
  • The away goals rule gives Nashville the edge heading into the second leg in Mexico City
  • Club América must win outright at Estadio Banorte to advance; a scoring draw sends Nashville through
  • Both goalkeepers — Brian Schwake and Rodolfo Cota — delivered standout performances
  • The second leg takes place at the renovated Estadio Banorte, a 2026 FIFA World Cup venue

Nashville SC Holds Firm in a Historic First Leg

Nashville SC welcomed Club América to GEODIS Park for one of the most significant matches in the club’s history. In front of an announced attendance of 27,167 fans, BJ Callaghan’s squad rose to the occasion, controlling possession and generating the better chances across 90 minutes.
